summary: Retest iteration 2. Found one CRITICAL frontend regression: Login.jsx used useEffect without importing it -> 'useEffect is not defined' PAGEERROR, blocking ALL UI flows because the login screen renders blank. I fixed this single-line import (added useEffect to the react import). After the fix, the full end-to-end UI flow PASSES: login -> simulate-inbound -> open conversation -> upload slip via ocr-file-input -> ocr-progress visible -> 6 ocr-rows rendered -> create-enquiry-button navigates to /enquiries/:id -> edit qty/gst -> finalize-enquiry-button navigates to /quotations/:id -> quotation-image renders -> send-quotation-button -> delivery-status shows 'sent' with 'Sent on WhatsApp' toast. CRM row navigation, CustomerProfile (stats/timeline/top-products), Inventory rate-cell inline edit, and Automation rule-card-{id} all PASS.

minor.issue: Signed file URL returned uses http:// scheme inside an https:// page -> 'Mixed Content' browser warning (auto-upgraded to https). Should use protocol-relative URL or honor request scheme.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect was used (line 18) WITHOUT importing it from React. Caused 'ReferenceError: useEffect is not defined' on every visit to /login, breaking the entire app (white screen, no inputs render). FIXED by changing `import { useState }` -> `import { useEffect, useState }`.

Button sits at viewport y=1082.5 in 1920x1080 viewport (overflow-auto sidebar) — Playwright force-clicks at element center which is outside viewport, so the React handler does not fire. Real users can scroll/click fine, but it makes E2E flaky. Suggest a sticky footer for the action button inside the ocr-rows aside.
Container has testid 'delivery-status' but its text content concatenates label + timestamp ('sentSent just now'). Minor — consider scoping testid to just the status word.

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) Add useEffect to React import in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx. Main agent should keep this fix.
(Optional) Make the 'Create enquiry' button sticky to the bottom of the right sidebar so it never falls below the viewport.
(Optional) Generate signed file URLs with https:// (or protocol-relative) to remove Mixed Content browser warnings.
(Optional) Tighten data-testid='delivery-status' scope so its text contains only the status (e.g. 'sent') and not the trailing timestamp.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx broke the whole app due to a missing import — every change to the Login redirect should be smoke-tested in the browser; consider adding a basic 'login page renders' Playwright test in CI.

Enquiry editor exposes testids `qty-input-{i}`, `rate-input-{i}`, `gst-input`, `finalize-enquiry-button`, `save-enquiry-button` (not the `enquiry-qty-*`/`enquiry-gst-input` names mentioned in the request). Naming is consistent within the page but worth aligning with the request spec / docs.
Backend logs show a passlib bcrypt warning ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') — non-blocking but noisy; consider pinning passlib/bcrypt or switching to bcrypt directly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all REST flows exercised end-to-end via UI succeed; iteration_1 had 21/22 pytest pass and Gemini model is now correct)
success_rate.frontend: 100% after my one-line fix to Login.jsx (was 0% before — blank login screen)

rca_of_the_issue: RCA (Login white screen): /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx line 18 uses useEffect(...) for the post-auth redirect, but line 1 imported only { useState } from 'react'. At runtime React threw 'ReferenceError: useEffect is not defined' inside the Login component render, the React error boundary remained empty, and the page rendered a blank canvas — preventing the entire iteration's UI testing. Mitigation applied: changed line 1 to `import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';`. Verified by re-running E2E: login -> /inbox succeeds and complete OCR-to-send flow passes.
